gaps: TØI Handbook (tshandbok.no) was not reachable, so Norwegian meta-analysed effects with confidence intervals, and ISA, interlock and education values, are missing; SafetyCube DSS synopses and SWOV were not opened this session.

No SF unit cost was read for a pedestrian hybrid beacon, refuge island, raised crosswalk, raised side-street crossing, protected left-turn phase, all-way stop, crosswalk restripe, red-light camera or no-turn-on-red signs.

No crash effect was found for failure-to-yield cameras, yield enforcement stings, pedestrian education, longer crossing times for older people, shorter signal waits, rear cameras, truck direct vision or weight-based fees.

The pedestrian-violation split by Vehicle Code section (outside a crosswalk vs against the signal vs stepping out) exists only for 2022 to 2024 KSI (125 people); a 2017 to 2024 split by section and by movement is not computed.
Unsignalized vs signalized share of each failure-to-yield movement is not computed, so beacons, all-way stops and raised side-street crossings cannot yet be given a target share.

Turn-on-red share of right-turn failure-to-yield crashes is SFMTA's 'nearly 20% of turn-related crashes', not a count from our data; the SFMTA Tenderloin NTOR evaluation summary was linked but not read.

Most SF night crashes were under working streetlights; lighting effects come from lit-vs-unlit studies, and only Sweden's 'doubling light on a lit road, -8%, not significant' fits SF. Lighting levels at SF crash sites are unmeasured.

The 'not stated' (292 hurt, 49 KSI), 'other' (139, 14), 'vehicle right of way' (65, 7), following too closely, dooring and phone-use pedestrian families have no fix records of their own; they are reached only by area-wide levers (speed, volume, vehicle AEB).
NYC Turn Calming's page does not describe its comparison method; the 2016 left-turn study is simple 3-year before and after with no control for regression to the mean.
Several cited figures (DUI, cameras, SF outcomes, school studies, costs) come from repo notes whose primaries were read on earlier dates; they carry [secondary — verify] here.
